conclusions.text: The full original source-relative request partitions into the independently matched foreign-source hold set and conservative supported complement. Only the latter passes the stock constructor.
Legal/current-boundary, physical-water interpretation, whole-feature semantics and final selected/emitted acceptance remain unresolved or pending.

limits: All 170526 original cells, 15252 intervals and 47 source subjects remain in scope. The exact conservative partition is 141263 supported cells across 46 owners plus 29263 held cells across 28 owners.
Owner 7564, gb:AGO:ADM2:16411231B15003183780679, is wholly held at 935 cells. It remains in source geometry, subject roster, manifest and original-scope dispositions.

Foreign ADM1 sources remain contrary evidence: NAM 15255 cells, COD 13269, COG 722 and ZMB 17. Whole unchanged geometries act as conservative exclusions; this is unresolved source disagreement, not a legal sovereignty determination.

The original zero-hold authority and composition are preserved but superseded. They are not selected or counted as accepted repairs. The revised authority qualifies only 141263 cells. Current selected composition, owner-zero and actual emitted-consumer acceptance remain pending.

The original six-family census preserves 241 features and 3618885 decoded bytes; supplementary complete NAM ADM2 and COD ADM2 products have 109 and 189 features and zero requested-centre conflicts. Each original vintage and licence remains retained.

Original AGO ADM2 represents simplified 2018 humanitarian municipal territory, not the distinct full-detail product or current-law territory. All 47 targets retain their same-named exclusive original source identity.
All 11 whole-feature physical issues remain unchanged. None intersects a requested centre of its own target; this does not establish whole-feature physical correctness.

Historical Namibia-Angola 21 components intersect 6150 requested centres; Angola-DRC ten intersect 6754; custody ten intersect 28. These are not disjoint repair totals. #1046/#896/#1243/#1268/#1397 remain unresolved in their distinct current-law, source/water and historical scopes.

All 6150 historical Namibia-Angola overlap centres are GSHHG land, while retained JRC v1.5 has positive occurrence at 2225, positive 2024 seasonality at 1136, and 12 water months at 655. Of the 427 centres outside the foreign-ADM1 holds, 139 have positive occurrence, 63 positive seasonality, 43 twelve-month water. These are contrary physical observations, not river median-line or owner adjudication; no modern dry-land claim is made.

Separate source-conflict 751-cell/35-owner and physical-interpretation 1987-cell/12-owner packages remain unrepaired and uncredited. No source geometry, whole component, current-law, regional certificate, historical import or deployment approval is asserted.
